title: The Humble man at the counter
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：humble　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 humble 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the counsellor wrote of ① a humble man at the counter in the journal, and everybody in the garden said at once that it was ② humbler than the one named there the year before. Three evenings on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the counsellor, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the humble ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the humblest man at the counter anybody in the garden had ever seen, or so the journal for June 1979 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too humble to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the listener who had come to help; the humble ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the letter at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a humble house by the road, and said that no listener in his right mind would call it ⑥ as humble as the house by the road they had once had in the old garden. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was humble or not, and he said so.

By 1992 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the journal. What the line asked for was ⑦ something humble, and nothing besides. The listener from the next garden called the whole plan ⑧ quite humble; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the journal kept the names of the humble ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1995, before dawn, she wrote of another humble man at the counter in the same journal, and the work, which took two evenings, seemed ⑨ humbler than anybody had expected. ⑩ The humblest house by the road in the whole garden, she said in 1997, was the one she could never quite name; the humble ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 谦逊（前置定语 a humble man at the counter：1985 年谈心人在心记里记下的那件谦逊的男人）
B. adj. 谦逊／简陋（比较级 humbler than：文中两处，一处比柜台后谦逊的男人，一处比预想）
C. adj. 谦逊／简陋（最高级 the humblest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 谦逊（表语 too humble to do：母亲觉得它太谦逊，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 简陋（前置定语 a humble house by the road：叔叔把整件事称作一桩简陋的房子）
F. adj. 简陋（同级比较 as humble as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩路边简陋的房子相比）
G. adj. 简陋（后置定语 something humble：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 简陋（受程度副词修饰 quite humble：那位倾听者的评价）

items.q: a humble man at the counter
the humblest man at the counter anybody
a humble house by the road
The humblest house by the road in

answers.why: humble 意为“谦逊”，1985 年谈心人在心记里记下的是“一件谦逊的男人”，此处作前置定语 a humble man at the counter。
humble 意为“谦逊”，此处用比较级 humbler than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
humble 意为“谦逊”，心记上 六月 那行字说它是小园里最谦逊的一件，故用最高级 the humblest man at the counter。
humble 意为“谦逊”，母亲认为这件东西“太谦逊了，谁也用不上”，too humble to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
humble 意为“简陋”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩简陋的房子”，此处作前置定语 a humble house by the road。
humble 意为“简陋”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩路边简陋的房子一样简陋”，同级比较用 as humble as。
humble 意为“简陋”，心记上那半行字要的是“简陋的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something humble。
humble 意为“简陋”，邻小园来的那位倾听者认为这套计划“相当简陋”，quite 修饰原级 humble。
humble 意为“简陋”，1995 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要简陋”，故用比较级 humbler than。
humble 意为“简陋”，母亲 1997 年说的是“整个小园里最简陋的那一桩”，故用最高级 the humblest house by the road。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1985 年，谈心人在心记里记下了一件谦逊的男人。（a humble man at the counter）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更谦逊。（humbler than …）
母亲觉得它太谦逊，谁也用不上。（too humble to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩简陋的房子。（a humble house by the road）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩路边简陋的房子一样简陋。（as humble as …）
到了 1992 年，心记上只剩半行字：要的是一件简陋的东西。（something humble）
answers: In 1985 the counsellor wrote of a humble man at the counter in the journal.
Everybody said it was humbler than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too humble to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a humble house by the road.
He said nobody would call it as humble as the house by the road they had once had.
By 1992 the journal asked for nothing but something humble.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 humble 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1985 the counsellor wrote of a humble man at the counter in the journal, and nobody forgot it.
It was the humblest man at the counter in the garden, or so the journal says.
My mother thought it too humble to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a humble house by the road, and nobody argued with him.
The listener from the next garden called the plan quite humble, and everybody laughed.
The humble ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
